definitions.gloss: finishing a race; completing the full course
definitions.explanation: Successfully running or driving the entire distance of a race. The emphasis is on completing the course rather than winning.

examples.japanese: ⟦マラソン→マラソン：04732_marason⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{完走|かんそう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{完走|かんそう}⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{不安|ふあん}→不安：00836_fuan⟧だった。
examples.english: I was worried about whether I could finish the race.

examples.japanese: ⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧フルマラソン⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{完走|かんそう}⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{本当|ほんとう}→本当：00779_hontou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{嬉|うれ}しかった→嬉しい：00822_ureshii⟧。
examples.english: I was truly happy when I finished my first full marathon.

notes:
USAGE:
Primarily used for running races (marathons, relays) and motorsport (F1, car rallies). The focus is on completing the course, not on placement. For many amateur runners, {完走|かんそう} itself is the goal.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦マラソン→マラソン：04732_marason⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{完走|かんそう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to finish a marathon)
- {完走|かんそう}{証|しょう} (completion certificate)
- {完走|かんそう}⟦タイム→タイム：23539_taimu⟧ (finishing time)
- {完走|かんそう}⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧ (completion rate)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ゴール→ゴール：03845_gooru⟧: goal, finish line — the physical endpoint
- {完|かん}{走|そう} vs ⟦{感想|かんそう}→感想：00450_kansou⟧ vs ⟦{乾燥|かんそう}→乾燥：00184_kansou⟧: these are homophones — be careful with context
